detailed_notes: Plate mounted low on truck front chassis; downsampled from 4K to 640x640 reduces plate width below detector threshold. Fixable via multi-scale inference or ROI tile slicing.
Truck positioned at extreme left frame boundary; left-side letters cropped out of camera field of view. Physical camera framing limitation, not detector fault.
Truck entering at steep oblique angle at extreme right border (x=3507). Plate width heavily compressed by perspective; detected at 1280 resolution with conf=0.33.
Steep turn entering gate at right border (x=3543). Detected with high confidence (conf=0.78) when inference resolution increased to 1280.
Persistent steep oblique yaw angle entering lane (x=3542). Successfully detected at 1280 resolution with conf=0.81.
Heavy dust and road grime on lower truck bumper creating very low edge contrast against vehicle grille.
Truck entering further back in lane; plate width in 4K image is small (<120px) and lost during 640 downsampling.
Tricycle vehicle featuring square (two-line) plate mounted on non-standard side bracket. Standard detector bias toward rectangular car bumper plates misses this aspect ratio.
Horizontal motion smearing across bumper area as vehicle transits quickly before gate arm.
Plate mounted in deep recess under truck bumper overhang, casting a heavy shadow across top character half.
Plate width 155px in 4K frame; detected with conf=0.86 at 1280 resolution. Direct consequence of 640 downsampling artifact on 4K camera.
Truck turning sharply with ~60 deg horizontal yaw, compressing plate bounding box aspect ratio to 1.3.
Noticeable vehicle motion blur and camera shutter lag softening plate border edges.
Square tricycle plate with OOV letter Kaf; successfully detected at 1280 resolution with conf=0.74.
Nighttime high-beam truck headlight glare creating an 8.35% saturation bloom directly over the front bumper.
Intense headlight blooming obscuring right half of plate; requires local tone mapping or adaptive exposure control.
Monochrome IR night capture with severe retroreflective plate blowout and dark chassis shadow.
Night IR capture of entering tricycle; detected at 1280 resolution with conf=0.68. Affected by IR grain and sensor noise.
